title: Symlink-safe scanning and the agent rules layout
summary: This change makes `osf scan` treat symlinks as data rather than as the files they point at: a symlink is never walked or read, and every skipped link is counted as excluded so a scan of nothing but links can never read as clean. Alongside it, the repository's agent-facing rules are reorganised — a shared `.agents/skills` folder with `.claude/skills` as a git symlink to it, per-folder `AGENTS.md` files under `crates/` and `.github/workflows/`, and two new CI steps that lint every skill and fail the build if the Claude Code skills link is not a real symlink.

nodes.label: osf CLI
nodes.subtitle: osf scan / osf lint
nodes.summary: The command-line shell. It parses arguments, calls into the library crates, and prints the outcome.

nodes.label: scan_paths
nodes.subtitle: pub fn scan_paths(dir, paths, rules, excluder)
nodes.summary: Reads each resolved target, skipping binaries and excluded labels. It now also skips any target that is itself a symlink and seeds the excluded count with the links skipped during resolution.

nodes.label: resolve_scan_targets
nodes.subtitle: -> (Vec<(String, PathBuf)>, usize)
nodes.summary: Builds the list of files to scan. It now returns the number of symlinks skipped alongside the targets, so the caller can report them as excluded.

nodes.label: collect_files
nodes.subtitle: walk, never through a symlink
nodes.summary: Walks a directory into a file list. It now uses symlink_metadata and returns early on a symlink, incrementing the skipped counter, so a link that cycles back on an ancestor cannot recurse forever.

nodes.label: ScanOutcome
nodes.subtitle: files + excluded
nodes.summary: The result of a scan: the files read and the count of entries excluded. Skipped symlinks now land in the excluded count.

nodes.label: git tracked files
nodes.subtitle: crate::git::tracked_files
nodes.summary: Lists the files git tracks in the repository, used when no explicit paths are given.

nodes.label: .claude/skills
nodes.subtitle: symlink -> ../.agents/skills
nodes.summary: A git symlink so Claude Code, which reads only `.claude/skills`, sees the same skills as every other agent. CI fails if it is not recorded with git mode 120000 pointing at `../.agents/skills`.

nodes.label: .agents/skills
nodes.subtitle: shared skill folder
nodes.summary: The one home for skills an agent uses while working on this repository: adding-an-osf-command, filing-an-issue, opening-a-pull-request, reviewing-a-pull-request, running-sub-agents, writing-a-workflow.

nodes.label: skills/
nodes.subtitle: show-me, pr-outline
nodes.summary: The skills this repository ships to adopters, kept separate from the skills used only inside this repository.

nodes.label: hygiene job
nodes.subtitle: ci.yml
nodes.summary: The CI job that runs the repository's own checks. It gains two steps: lint every skill, and verify the Claude Code skills symlink.

nodes.label: Check the skills
nodes.subtitle: osf lint skill
nodes.summary: Collects every `skills/*/SKILL.md` and `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md` directory and runs `osf lint skill` over them, so a malformed skill fails the build.

nodes.label: Check the Claude Code skills link
nodes.subtitle: git mode 120000
nodes.summary: Reads the git mode of `.claude/skills` and its readlink target, failing with a fix hint when it is not a symlink to `../.agents/skills`.

nodes.label: .github/workflows/AGENTS.md
nodes.subtitle: rules for workflow files
nodes.summary: Folder-scoped rules: jobs that read a secret or decide a merge live on the base branch, actions are pinned to a commit SHA, permissions are minimal, and review aids never block a merge.

nodes.label: crates/AGENTS.md
nodes.subtitle: rules for crates/
nodes.summary: Folder-scoped rules for the Rust crates: the binary stays thin, logic lives in library crates, and the four local checks that must pass before a push.

nodes.label: scan tests
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/tests/scan.rs
nodes.summary: Five new tests cover a tracked symlink to a directory, a repository of only a symlink, an explicit symlinked path, a symlinked directory found while walking, and a symlink cycle.

nodes.label: TempRepo::symlink
nodes.subtitle: test fixture helper
nodes.summary: Creates a symlink in a temporary repository, resolving the target relative to the link's parent and choosing file or directory symlinks on Windows.
